name: Jiko o Kaeru Hishou Dennou Juku
original_name: 自己を変える飛翔電脳塾
source:
Virtual seminars that you can pick and play like a visual novel. Something in here for everyone, feel your spirit soar along to the beautiful melodies and moving backdrops, with these 20 uplifting essays.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233344.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你可以像视觉小说一样挑选和玩虚拟研讨会。这里有适合每个人的内容，通过这20篇令人振奋的文章，感受你的精神随着优美的旋律和动人的背景而翱翔。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233344.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
